name: ai.inite/inite-visibility
title: INITE
description: INITE for agents: services and booking, AI visibility audit, an Atlas of AI tools. Token optional.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Without it every open tool answers, under per-address allowances, and the audit runs as the survey. Bearer <access_token> adds the member tools and the account's tier; a member tool called without one answers 401 with WWW-Authenticate pointing at https://inite.ai/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/api/mcp, which names auth.inite.ai.

environmentVariables.name: INITE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Access token for inite.ai. Optional: three checks run locally without one. Run `npx @inite/visibility login` to add the full audit.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.auth: none for the local checks, oauth2 for the full audit
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.quota: the account's own daily allowance, same as the web app
